analytics.name: Analytic 1927
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies malformed or out-of-spec ICS protocol exchanges targeting an embedded device from a source outside the approved communication baseline. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when execution violates an approved signer/hash/path/parent/process or tool allowlist, or originates from an unauthorized user/tool, and is tied to an OT asset or follow-on OT-relevant action. Suppress vendor-signed software, approved engineering utilities, diagnostics, patching, backup, and documented maintenance.

tuning.description: Time window correlating a memory access event with a subsequent crash.
Allowlist of legitimate security/diagnostic tools authorized to perform cross-process memory access.

log_sources.name: NSM:Content
log_sources.channel: anomalous protocol exchange preceding device behavioral change (reboot, altered configuration)
